what_author_would_change: Optional: 'captures ... and turns it into' reads a little better than 'captures ... to turn'. Not required.

reasons: 'aas는 여러 계정을 나란히 사용하며' makes aas the subject that uses the accounts. The user uses them; aas makes that possible. 'Side by side' is calqued as '나란히 사용', which no native writer would put this way.
'나란히 사용하며 즉시 전환하고 ... 보여줍니다' chains three verbs onto the wrong subject, so the sentence reads like a translation.
what_author_would_change: Something like: 'aas로 여러 계정을 함께 쓰면서 명령 하나로 전환하고, 계정마다 남은 사용량을 한눈에 볼 수 있습니다.'
Optional: naming Claude Code/Codex would help orient readers. Not required.

reasons: '곧바로 그 창으로 옮겨 줍니다' has no object, so it reads as if Tend moves the window or the agent rather than taking the user there.
'창' is the usual Korean for a tmux window, but Tend jumps to the agent's pane (source: 'takes you straight to its pane').
what_author_would_change: '곧바로 그 pane으로 이동시켜 줍니다' or '그 에이전트가 있는 pane으로 바로 데려다 줍니다'.

reasons: '과정을 매번 처음부터 다시 밟게 됩니다' has no clear subject: who retraces the steps, the user or the model? It also misstates the problem. The source says the model has to 'reason through every routine step again' (repeated model calls and tokens), not that the user repeats a process.
'클로드와 코덱스' is an unnatural transliteration. Korean developers write Claude and Codex in Latin script.
'조작하게 만들 때' is awkward. '조작하게 할 때' is the natural form.
what_author_would_change: Rewrite the first sentence around the real cost, e.g. 'Claude나 Codex에게 앱 조작을 맡기면 같은 작업도 매번 모델이 처음부터 다시 추론합니다.'

reasons: It leaves out what the product is for. Its tagline is 'Make it once. Use it again.' (save the run as a Flow, replay it with zero model calls), and without that the post describes generic computer use that any agent tool offers.

'verifies results before completing a task' overstates the sources. They say it checks outcomes but also 'Not every demo completed without intervention', and TextEdit 'stopped when save evidence was insufficient'.
'Want to let Claude and Codex ...?' is an ad-style hook.
what_author_would_change: Lead with reuse, e.g. 'Haejo lets Claude and Codex operate your Mac and browser apps, then saves what they did as a Flow you can replay without model calls.'

reasons: '메뉴바가 작은 아이콘들과 브라우저 탭으로 복잡해질 때가 있습니다' is wrong: browser tabs are not in the menu bar. The source lists menu bar icons, browser tabs and apps kept open as separate places where things are scattered.
'날씨, 달력, 시스템 상태 같은 도구' calls weather and system stats '도구'. They are widgets or information, not tools.
what_author_would_change: '자주 보는 정보가 메뉴바 아이콘, 브라우저 탭, 켜 둔 앱에 흩어져 있습니다. BarShelf는 날씨, 달력, 시스템 상태 같은 위젯을 메뉴바 아이콘 하나에 모아 팝업으로 보여 줍니다.'

reasons: 'Your menu bar can become a junk drawer of tiny icons and open tabs' has the same error: open tabs are not in the menu bar. The source contrasts one icon with 'a row of tiny ones, a browser tab, and an app you keep open'.

'gathers weather, calendar, and scripts' mixes data with scripts, which are only widget sources, so the list is uneven. 'behind one menu bar icon and popup' is clumsy because nothing sits 'behind' a popup.
what_author_would_change: 'The things you check all day are scattered across menu bar icons, browser tabs, and apps kept open. BarShelf puts weather, calendar, system stats, or any script's output into one menu bar icon and popup.'
